a: "Uma illu eved kohen shebbarach veeshet kohen shemmarda al balah – halo ochlim bitruma; veze – eno ochel" –
Shappir kaamar lehu! amar rava: hayeynu deka mahderi leh bematnitin: mippene shehu kinyano. dei bae, shakel arbaa zuze miyyisrael ufasel leh kol hecha deiteh.
Ulerabbi meir – tinach eved kohen, eved yisrael may ikka lememar? amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: mippene shemmafsido mishshifcha kenaanit.
Adderabba, hare hu mattiro bevat chorin! avda behefkera nicha leh – zila leh, shechicha leh, peritza leh.
Mishna haomer "tenu get ze leishti, shetar shichrur ze leavdi", umet – lo yittenu leachar mita. "tenu mane leish peloni", umet – yittenu leachar mita.
Gemara amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: vehu shetztzevurin umunnachin bekeren zavit.
Bemay askinan? ilema bevari, ki tzevurin may have? ha la meshach! veella bishchiv mera, may irya tzevurin? ki en tzevurin name, deha kayyma lan dedivre shechiv mera – kichtuvim vechimsurin damu!
Amar rav zevid: leolam bevari, vechidrav huna amar rav – deamar rav huna amar rav: "mane li beyadcha, tenehu lo lifloni", bemaamad shelashtan – kana.
Rav pappa amar: leolam bishchiv mera, ucheiddach derav – deamar rav: shechiv mera sheamar "tenu mane lifloni minnechasay"; "mane ze" – notnin, "mane" setam – en notnin,
Chayyshinan shemma mane kavur kaamar.
Vehilcheta: likvura la chayyshinan. rav pappa may tama la amar kerav zevid?
b: Kasavar rav pappa, ki amar rav – la shena bemilve, vela shena befikkadon.
Rav zevid may tama la amar kerav pappa? la mittokma matnitin bishchiv mera. mimmay? middekatane: "haomer tenu get ze leishti ushetar shichrur ze leavdi", umet – lo yittenu leachar mita.
Tama demet, ha mechayyim – notnin; tama deamar "tenu", ha lo amar "tenu", en notnin; ushechiv mera – af al gav dela amar "tenu", notnin.
Ditnan, barishona hayu omrim: hayyotze bekolar, veamar "kitvu get leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar, af hamefaresh vehayyotze bishyayra.
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af hamesukkan.
Matkef la rav ashe: uman nema lan dematnitin rabbi shimon shezuri hi? dilma rabbanan hi!
Gufa – amar rav huna amar rav: "mane li beyadcha, tenehu lo lifloni", bemaamad shelashtan – kana. amar rava: mistabbera milleteh derav befikkadon, aval bemilva – lo.
Vehaelohim! amar rav: afillu bemilva. ittemar name, amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi: "milva li beyadcha, tenehu lo lifloni", bemaamad shelashtan – kana.
Vetama may? amar ammemar: naasa keomer lo bishat mattan maot: shabadna lach ledidach ulechol deatu mechamatach.
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar: ella meatta, hikna lannoladim – dela havo bishat mattan maot, hachi name dela kanu?!
Daafillu lerabbi meir, deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam, hane mille ledavar sheyyeshno beolam, aval ledavar sheeno baolam – la!
Ella amar rav ashe:

a: Behahi hanaa deka mishtanneya leh ben milva yeshana lemilva chadasha, gamar umeshabed nafsheh.
Amar leh huna mar bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe: ella meatta, kegon hane deve bar elyashiv, dechafti veshakli lealtar, hachi name dela kanu?!
Vechi tema hachi name, im ken natatta devarecha leshiurin!

Ella amar mar zutera: hane telat mille shavvinhu rabbanan kehilcheta bela tama: chada – ha; veiddach – deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkotev kol nechasav leishto – lo asaah ella appitroppeya; veiddach – deamar rav chananya: hammassi ishsha livno gadol babbayit – kenao.
Amar leh rav lerav acha bardela: kabba demorika it li gabbach; yahaveh lifloni. beappeh kaamena lach dela hadarna bi.
Mikkelal dei bae hadar beh, matze hadar beh?! hachi kaamar: devarim hallalu lo nittenu lachazara.
Ha amar rav chada zimna; deamar rav huna amar rav: "mane li beyadcha, tenehu lo lifloni", bemaamad shelashtan – kana!
I mehahi, hava amena hane mille mattana merubba, aval mattana muetet la live befanav, ka mashma lan.
Hanhu ginnae daavuyd chushebana bahade hadade. pash chamesh istere zuze gabbe chad minnayyhu, amri leh: "yahavinhu nihaleh lemare ara" – beappe mare ara, ukeno minneh.
Lesof azal avad chushebana ben dileh lenafsheh, la pash gabbeh vela midde. ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: may ebed lach? chada, deamar rav huna amar rav. veod, ha keno minnach.
Amar leh rava: attu hay, mi kaamar "la yahavina"?! "delekka gabbay" kaamar! amar leh: im ken, kinyan betaut hu, vechol kinyan betaut chozer.
Ittemar: "holech mane lifloni sheani chayyayv lo", amar rav: chayyayv beachrayuto; veim ba lachzor – eno chozer. ushemuel amar: mittoch shechayyayv beachrayuto, im ba lachzor – chozer.
Lema beha kamippalgi – demar savar: "holech" kizchi" dame, umar savar: "holech" lav kizchi" dame?
La; dechulle alma "holech" kizchi" dame, vehacha beha kamippalgi – mar savar: la amrinan miggo. umar savar: amrinan miggo.

Tanya kevoteh derav: "holech mane lifloni sheani chayyayv lo"; "ten mane lifloni sheani chayyayv lo"; "holech mane lifloni – pikkadon sheyyesh lo beyadi"; "ten mane lifloni – pikkadon sheyyesh lo beyadi" – chayyayv beachrayuto, veim ba lachzor – eno chozer.
Pikkadon, lema leh: en retzono sheyyehe pikdono beyad acher! amar rabbi zera: keshehuchezak kafran.
Rav sheshet hava leh asharta desarbale bemachoza. amar leh lerav yosef bar chama: bahade deatet, ayytinhu nihali. azal, yahavinhu leh. amri leh: nikne minnach; amar lehu: in.
Lesof ishtemit lehu. ki ata legabbeh, amar leh: shappir avadt, dela shavvit nafshach "eved love leish malve". lishshana acharina: shappir avadt; "eved love leish malve".
Rabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya hava leh ispeka dechaspa binhardea,
b: Amar lehu lerabbi dostay bar rabbi yannay ulerabbi yose bar kefar: bahade deatetu, atyu nihali. azul, yahaveh nihaleh. amri lehu: nikne minnayychu; amri lehu: la. amri lehu: ahdereh nihalan.
Rabbi dostay berabbi yannay amar lehu: in; rabbi yose bar kefar amar lehu: la. havo ka metzaaru leh, amar leh: chazi mar hechi ka aved! amar lehu: tav remo leh.
Ki ato legabbeh, amar leh: chazi mar, la missatyeh dela sayyeyan, ella amar lehu name "tav remo leh"! amar leh: ammay tebed hachi?

Amar leh: otan bene adam – hen amma, vechovaan ammah, umedabberin mechetzyehen, ushemotehen mevohalin: 'arda vearta ufile beresh; omrin "kefotu" – koftin; omrin "harogu" – horgin; illu hargu et dostay, mi natan leyannay abba bar kemoti.
Amar leh: bene adam hallalu kerovim lammalchut hen? amar leh: hen. yesh lahen susim uferadim sheratzim acharehen? amar leh: hen. amar leh: i hachi, shappir avadt.
"Holech mane lifloni", vehalach uvikkesho velo metzao – tane chada: yachzeru lamshalleach; vetanya iddach: leyorshe mi shennishtalchu lo.
Lema beha kamippalgi – demar savar: "holech" kizchi", umar savar: "holech" lav kizchi"?
Amar rabbi abba bar memel: dechulle alma "holech" lav kizchi"; vela kashya – ha bevari, ha bishchiv mera.
Rav zevid amar: ha veha bishchiv mera; ha – deiteh limkabbel bishat mattan maot, ha – deleteh limkabbel bishat mattan maot.
Rav pappa amar: ha veha bevari; ha – demit mekabbel bechayye noten, ha – demit noten bechayye mekabbel.

Lema "holech" kizchi" tannae hi? detanya: "holech mane lifloni", vehalach uvikkesho velo metzao, yachzeru lamshalleach. met meshalleach – rabbi natan verabbi yaakov amru: yachzeru leyorshe meshalleach, veyesh omrim: leyorshe mi shennishtalchu lo.

Rabbi yehuda hannasi amar mishshum rabbi yaakov, sheamar mishshum rabbi meir: mitzva lekayyem divre hammet. vachachamim omrim: yachloku. vechan amru: kol ma sheyyirtze shaliach – yaase. amar rabbi shimon hannasi: al yadi haya maase, veamru: yachzeru leyorshe meshalleach.

May, lav beha kamippalgi – detanna kamma savar: "holech" lav kizchi"; verabbi natan verabbi yaakov name – "holech" lav kizchi", veaf al gav demit, la amrinan "mitzva lekayyem divre hammet"; veyesh omrim – "holech" kizchi";
Rabbi yehuda hannasi amar mishshum rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir – "holech" lav kizchi", mihu, hecha demit, amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet;
Vachachamim omrim: yachloku – mesappeka lehu; vechan amru – shuda adif; verabbi shimon hannasi – maase ata leashmoinan.
La, bevari dechulle alma la peligi; vehacha bemay askinan – bishchiv mera, uviflugeta derabbi elazar verabbanan kamippalgi.

Ditnan: hamechallek nechasav al piv, rabbi elazar omer: echad bari veechad mesukkan; nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut – niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vesheen lahen achrayut – en niknin ella bimshicha. vachachamim omrim: ellu vaellu niknin baamira.
Amru lo: maase beimman shel bene rochel shehayta chola, veamra: "tinnaten

a: Kevinti levitti, vehi bishnem asar mane", umeta, vekiyyeymu chachamim et devareha! amar lahem: bene rochel tikberem immam.
Tanna kamma kerabbi elazar; verabbi natan verabbi yaakov name kerabbi elazar – af al gav demit, la amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet; veyesh omrim" – kerabbanan;

Verabbi yehuda hannasi sheamar mishshum rabbi meir – kerabbi elazar, mihu hecha demit amrinan mitzva lekayyem divre hammet; vachachamim omrim: yachloku – mesappeka lehu; vechan amru – shuda adif; verabbi shimon hannasi – maase ata leashmoinan.
Ibbaya lehu: rabbi shimon hannasi; nasi hu, o mishshemeh denasi kaamar? ta shema, deamar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi shimon hannasi. vaadayin tibbee lach: nasi hu, o dekaamar mishshemeh denasi? teku.
Gufa – amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi shimon hannasi. veha kayyma lan divre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu!
Rav yosef moke la bevari. veha leyorshe meshalleach kaamar, vekayyma lan: mitzva lekayyem divre hammet! teni: yachzeru limshalleach.
Hadaran alach hammevi kamma

Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, veamar: "befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam"; "befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav"; "befanay nichtav kullo uvefanay nechtam chetzyo"; "befanay nichtav chetzyo uvefanay nechtam kullo" – pasul.

Echad omer "befanay nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam", pasul. shenayim omrim "befanenu nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam", pasul; verabbi yehuda machshir. echad omer "befanay nichtav" ushenayim omrim "befanenu nechtam", kasher.
Gemara ha tu lema li? ha tena leh chada zimna – hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, tzarich sheyyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"! i mehahi hava amena: tzarich, vei la amar kasher; ka mashma lan.

"Befanay nichtav chetzyo uvefanay nechtam kullo", pasul. he chetzyo? illema chetzyo rishon, vehaamar rabbi elazar: afillu lo katav bo ella shita achat lishmah, shuv eno tzarich! ella amar rav ashe: chetzyo acharon.
"Befanay nichtav kullo uvefanay nechtam chetzyo", pasul. amar rav chisda: vaafillu shenayim meidim al chatimat yad sheni – pasul. may tama?
O kullo bekiyyum hagget, o kullo betakkanat chachamim.
Matkef la rava: mi ikka midde deillu amar chad, kasher; hasheta deikka tere, pasul?! ella amar rava: afillu
b: Hu veacher meidin al chatimat yad sheni – pasul. may tama? atu leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma, veka nafek neche riva demamona appumma dechad sahada.
Matkef la rav ashe: mi ikka midde, deillu massek leh ihu lechulleh dibbura, kasher; hasheta deikka chad bahadeh, pasul?!
Ella amar rav ashe: afillu omer "ani hu ed sheni" – pasul. may tama? o kullo bekiyyum hagget, o kullo betakkanat chachamim.

Tenan: "befanay nichtav kullo, befanay nechtam chetzyo", pasul. iddach chetzyo hechi dame? illema delekka deka mashed aleh kelal; hasheta echad omer "befanay nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam", dehay kamashed akkulla ketiva vehay kamashed akkulla chatima, pasul; chetzyo mibbaya?!
Ella o kidrava o kidrav ashe,
Uleappoke midderav chisda.
Amar lecha rav chisda: uletamaych, "befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam" lamma li? ella lo zo af zo katane,
Hacha name la zo af zo katane.
Amar rav chisda: giddud chamishsha umechitza chamishsha – en mitztarfin, ad sheyyehe o kullo bimchitza o kullo begiddud.
Daresh marimar: giddud chamishsha umechitza chamishsha – mitztarfin. vehilcheta: mitztarfin.
Bae ilfa: yadayim – tehorot lachatzain, o en tehorot lachatzain? hechi dame? illema deka mashu be tere merviit, veha tenan: merviit notlin layyadayim, leechad vaafillu lishnayim!
Veella deka mashe chada chada yedeh, vehatnan: hannotel yado achat bintila, veachat bishtifa, yadav tehorot!
Veella deka mashe palga palga deyadeh, vehaamri deve rabbi yannay: yadayim – en tehorot lachatzain! la tzericha, deikka mashke tofeach.
Vechi ikka mashke tofeach may have? vehatnan:

a: Hannitztzok, vehakkatafres, umashke tofeach – eno chibbur lo letumea velo letohora!
La tzericha, deikka tofeach lehatepiach. ha name tenena: tofeach lehatepiach – chibbur!
Dilma leinyan mikvaot, verabbi yehuda hi. ditnan: mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvvanot, veyardu shenayim vetavlu (shenehem bevat achat – tehorim),
Beze achar ze – rishon tahor, vehashsheni tame.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im hayu raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim – af hashsheni tahor.

Amar rabbi yirmeya, hare amru: habba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin, vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin – tame; bae rabbi yirmeya: chetzyo bevia vechetzyo binfila, may? teku.
Amar rav pappa, hare amru: baal keri chole, shennatnu alav tisha kabbin mayim – tahor; bae rav pappa: chetzyo bitvila vechetzyo bintina, may? teku.
Echad omer "befanay nichtav" veechad omer kulei: amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheen hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem, aval get yotze mittachat yede shenehem –
b: Kasher. alma kasavar shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, en tzerichin sheyyomru: "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam".
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, sefa dekatane: shenayim omrim "befanenu nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam" – pasul, verabbi yehuda machshir;
Tama deen hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem, ha get yotze mittachat yede shenehem – machsheri rabbanan?! amar leh: in.
Vechi en get yotze mittachat yede shenehem bemay peligi? mar savar: gazrinan dilma atya leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma – beed echad; umar savar: la gazrinan.

Lishshana acharina amri la: amar rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi yochanan: afillu get yotze mittachat yede shenehem – pasul. alma kasavar shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, tzerichin sheyyomru "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam".

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, sefa dekatane: shenayim omrim "befanenu nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam" – pasul, verabbi yehuda machshir; afillu get yotze mittachat yede shenehem pasli rabbanan?! amar leh: in.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: lefi sheen bekiin lishmah, umar savar: lefi sheen edim metzuyin lekayyeymo.
Lema derabba verava tannae hi? la; rava metaretz kelishshana kamma,
Verabba amar lach: dechulle alma baenan lishmah, vehacha bemay askinan – leachar shellamdu;
Uvigzera shemma yachzor haddavar lekilkulo kamippalgi – demar savar gazrinan, umar savar la gazrinan.
Veliflog name rabbi yehuda beresha! ha ittemar ala, amar ulla: chaluk haya rabbi yehuda af barishona.
Metiv rav oshaya leulla: rabbi yehuda machshir bezo velo beacheret. may, lav lemaote echad omer "befanay nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam"?!

La, lemaote "befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav" – salka datach amena: hoil vela gazar rabbi yehuda gezera shemma yachzor davar lekilkulo; dilma ate leichallofe bekiyyum shetarot dealma, beed echad – name la gazar; ka mashma lan.
Ittemar name, amar rav yehuda: shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan.

Rabba bar bar chana chalash, ul legabbeh rav yehuda verabba, leshayyole beh. beo minneh: shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, tzerichin sheyyomru "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam", o en tzerichin? amar lahem: en tzerichin – ma illu yomru "befanenu gershah", mi la mehemni?! addehachi, ata hahu

a: Chavra, shekala lishraga mikkammayyhu. amar: rachamana! o betullach, o betulla devar esav.

Lememra deromae meallu mipparsae?! vehatane rabbi chiyyay, may dichtiv: "elohim hevin darkah vehu yada et mekomah"? yodea hakkadosh baruch hu beyisrael sheen yecholin lekabbel gezerat romiyyim, amad vehigla otam levavel.
La kashya; ha mikkamme deneto chabbare levavel, ha levatar daato chabbare levavel.

Echad omer "befanay nichtav" ushenayim omrim "befanenu nechtam" – kasher: amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shehagget yotze mittachat yad ed ketiva, denaasu kishnayim al ze vechishnayim al ze; aval mittachat yede ede chatima – pasul.

Alma kasavar: shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, tzerichin sheyyomru: "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam". amar leh rabbi assi, ella meatta, resha dekatane: shenayim omrim "befanenu nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam" – pasul, verabbi yehuda machshir; vaafillu get yotze mittachat yede shenehem – pasli rabbanan?! amar leh: in.

Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar, daafillu get yotze mittachat yede ede chatima – kasher. alma kasavar: shenayim sheheviu get mimmedinat hayyam, en tzerichin sheyyomru: "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam".

Amar leh rabbi assi: ella meatta, resha dekatane: shenayim omrim "befanenu nichtav" veechad omer "befanay nechtam" – pasul, verabbi yehuda machshir; tama deen hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem, ha get yotze mittachat yede shenehem – machsheri rabbanan?!
Amar leh: in. veha zimnin la amart lan hachi! amar leh: yated hi shello tamut.
Mishna nichtav bayyom venechtam bayyom; ballayla venechtam ballayla; ballayla venechtam bayyom – kasher. bayyom venechtam ballayla – pasul; rabbi shimon machshir.
Shehaya rabbi shimon omer: kol haggittin shennichtevu bayyom venechtemu ballayla – pesulin; chutz miggitte nashim.
Gemara ittemar: mippene ma tikkenu zeman begittin? rabbi yochanan amar: mishshum bat achoto.
Resh lakish amar: mishshum perot.
Resh lakish, may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan? amar lach:
b: Zenut la shechicha.
Verabbi yochanan, may tama la amar keresh lakish? kasavar: yesh levaal perot ad sheat netina.
Bishlama leresh lakish, mishshum hachi ka machshayr rabbi shimon. ella lerabbi yochanan, may tama derabbi shimon – demachshayr?
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: allibba derabbi shimon la kaamena, ki kaamena allibba derabbanan.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, hayeynu deikka ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan; ella leresh lakish, may ikka ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan?
Pere demishsheat ketiva vead sheat chatima ikka benayyhu.
Veha ippecha shaminan lehu! deittemar: meematay motziin leferot? rabbi yochanan amar: mishsheat ketiva, veresh lakish amar: mishsheat netina!
Efoch.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: shelosha gittin pesulim, veim nissat – havvalad kasher; ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatan? ahano dilchattechilla la tinnase.
Gazyeh lizman dideh, veyahaveh nihala, may? amar leh: lerammay la chayyshinan.
Katuv bo shavua, shana, chodesh, shabbat, may? amar leh: kasher. uma hoilu chachamim betakkanatan?

Ahno leshavua dekammeh uleshavua devatreh. dei la tema hachi, yoma gufeh – mi yadinan i mitztzafra i mippanya?! ella leyoma dekammeh uleyoma devatreh; hacha name, ahni leshavua dekammeh uleshavua devatreh.
Amar leh ravina lerava: katveh

a: Veotveh bechisteh – dei mippayyeysah tippayyays, may?
Amar leh: la makdem inash pureanuta lenafsheh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: gittin habbaim mimmedinat hayyam, demikkatvi benisan vela matu ad tishre – ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatam? amar leh: hanhu, kala it lehu.
Ittemar: meematay monin lagget? rav amar: mishsheat netina, ushemuel amar: mishsheat ketiva.
Matkef la rav natan bar hoshaya lishmuel, yomru: shete nashim bechatzer achat – zo asura vezo mutteret! amar leh abbaye: zo zeman gittah mochiach aleha, vezo zeman gittah mochiach aleha.

Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh dishmuel. tanya kevoteh derav: hashsholeach get leishto, venishtaha shaliach badderech shelosha chodashim, keshehiggia get leyadah – tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim; uleget yashan en choshshin, shehare lo nityayched immah.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: hammashlish get leishto, veamar lo: al tittenehu lah ella leachar shelosha chodashim, mishshennetano lah – mutteret linnase miyyad; uleget yashan en choshshin, shehare lo nityayched immah.
Rav kahana verav pappe verav ashe – avdi mishsheat ketiva, rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua – avdi mishsheat netina. vehilcheta: mishsheat ketiva.
Ittemar: meematay ketubba meshammetet?
Rav amar: mishshettifgom – vetizkof. ushemuel amar: pagma – af al pi shello zakfa, zakfa – af al pi shello pagma.
Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh dishmuel. tanya kevoteh derav: meematay ketubba meshammetet? mishshettifgom vetizkof. pagma velo zakfa, zakfa velo pagma – enah meshammetet, ad shettifgom vetizkof.
Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: ones, ukenas, ufittuy, uchetubbat ishsha – shezzekafan bemilva, meshammetin; veim lav – en meshammetin. meematay nizkafim bemilva? mishsheat haamada baddin.

Amar shemuel: ketubba kemaase bet din damya – ma maase bet din nichtavin bayyom venechtamin ballayla, af ketubba nichtevet bayyom venechtemet ballayla. ketubbeteh derabbi chiyyay bar rav ikketuv bayyom veichatum ballayla; hava rav hatam vela amar lehu vela midde.
Lema kishmuel sevira leh? asukin beoto inyan havo. detanya, amar rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok: lo shanu, ella kesheen asukin beoto inyan, aval asukin beoto inyan – kasher.
Rabbi shimon machshir: amar rava: may tama derabbi shimon? kasavar: kevan shennatan enav legarshah, shuv en lo perot.
Amar resh lakish: lo hichshir rabbi shimon ella lealtar, aval mikkan vead asara yamim – lo;
b: Chayyshinan shemma piyyes. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu mikkan vead asara yamim; im ita defayyes – kala it lay lemilleta.
Ittemar: amar laasara "kitvu get leishti"; amar rabbi yochanan: shenayim mishshum edim, vechullam mishshum tenay. veresh lakish amar: kullam mishshum edim.
Hechi dame? illema dela amar lehu: "kullechem"; veha tenan, amar laasara: "kitvu get leishti" – echad kotev ushenayim chotmin! ella daamar lehu "kullechem".
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu – dachatum be tere minnayyhu beyomeh, veinach mikkan vead asara yamim. man deamar mishshum tenay – kasher; uman deamar mishshum edim – pasul.
I name – kegon shennimtza echad mehem karov o pasul. leman deamar mishshum tenay – kasher; leman deamar mishshum edim – pasul.
I chatim bitchilla karov o pasul; amri lah kasher, veamri la pasul. amri lah kasher – tenay hu; amri la pasul – ate leichallofe bishtarot dealma.
Hahu daamar lehu laasara: "kitvu get leishti"; chatum be tere minnayyhu beyomeh, veinach – mikkan vead asara yamim. ata lekammeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar leh:

a: Keday hu rabbi shimon lismoch alav bishat haddechak.
Vehaamar resh lakish: lo hichshir rabbi shimon ella lealtar, aval mikkan vead asara yamim – la! behahi, kerabbi yochanan sevira leh.
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: shenayim mishshum edim, vechullan mishshum tenay! behahi, keresh lakish sevira leh.
Mishna bakkol kotvim – bidyo, besam, besikra, uvekomos, uvekankantom, uvechol davar shehu shel kayyayma. en kotvin lo bemashkin, velo beme ferot, velo bechol davar sheeno mitkayyem.

Al hakkol kotvin – al heale shel zayit; veal hakkeren shel para – venoten lah et happara; al yad shel eved – venoten lah et haeved. rabbi yose haggelili omer: en kotvin lo al davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, velo al haochalim.
Gemara deyo – deyota. sam – samma. sikra – amar rabba bar bar chana: sekarta shema. komos – koma. kankantom – amar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel: charta deushekafe.
Uvechol davar shehu mitkayyem vechulei: leetoye may? leetoye ha detane rabbi chanina: ketavo beme tarya veaftza – kasher. tane rabbi chiyyay: ketavo baavar, bishchor uveshichor – kasher.

Ittemar: hammaavir deyo al gabbe sikra, bashshabbat; rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu – chayyayv shetayim: achat mishshum kotev, veachat mishshum mochek. deyo al gabbe deyo, sikra al gabbe sikra – patur. sikra al gabbe deyo – amri la: chayyayv, veamri la: patur.
Amri la chayyayv – mochek hu. amri la patur – mekalkel hu.
Bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: edim sheen yodim lachtom; mahu sheyyichtevu lahem besikra, veyachtemu ketav elyon? ketav, o eno ketav? amar leh: eno ketav.
Amar leh: vahalo limmadtanu rabbenu, ketav elyon – ketav leinyan shabbat! amar leh: vechi mippene sheanu medammin naase maase?!
Ittemar: edim sheen yodim lachtom; rav amar: mekarin lahem neyayr chalak, umemalleim et hakkeraim deyo. ushemuel amar: baavar.
Baavar salka datach?! vehatane rabbi chiyyay: ketavo baavar, bishchor uveshichor – kasher! la kashya: ha – baavara, ha – bemayya daavara.
Rabbi avahu amar: beme melin. vehatane rabbi chanina: ketavo beme tarya veaftza – kasher!
La kashya: ha daafitz, ha dela afitz; sheen me melin al gabbe me melin.
Rav pappa amar: berok. vechen ori leh rav pappa lefappa toraa: berok. vehane mille begittin, aval bishtarot – la,
Dehahu daavad ovada bishar shetarot, venaggedeh rav kahana.
b: Tanya kevoteh derav: edim sheen yodin lachtom, mekarin lahen neyayr chalak umemalleim et hakkeraim deyo.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – begitte nashim; aval beshichrure avadim ushear kol hashshetarot, im yodin likrot velachtom – chotmin, veim lav – en chotmin.

Keriyyay man dechar shema? chassore michassera, vehachi katane: edim sheen yodin likrot – korin lifnehem vechotmim, vesheen yodin lachtom kulei. amar rabbi shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim, begitte nashim; aval shichrure avadim ushear kol hashshetarot, im yodin likrot velachtom – chotmin, veim lav – en chotmin.
Amar rabbi elazar: may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel? shello yehu benot yisrael agunot.
Amar rava: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. verav gammada mishshemeh derava amar: en halacha. veella keman, kerabbanan?!
Veha hahu daavad ovada bishar shetarot, venaggedeh rav kahana! targema akkeria.

Rav yehuda mitztaar kare vechatem. amar leh ulla: la tzerichat, deha rabbi elazar mara deeretz yisrael – karu kammeh vechatem, verav nachman – karu kammeh safre dayyayne vechatem. vedavvka rav nachman vesafre dayyayne, deit lehu emta, aval rav nachman vesafre acharine, safre dayyayne veinish acharina – la.
Rav pappa, ki hava ate lekammeh shetara parsaa daavid bearkaot shel goyim, makre lehu lishne goyim ze shello bifne ze bemesiach lefi tummo, umagbe beh mimmeshabedi.
Amar rav ashe: amar li rav huna bar natan, hachi amar ammemar: hay shetara parsaa dachatimi aleh sahadi yisrael, magbenan beh mimmeshabedi.
Veha la yadi lemikre! bidyadi. veha baenan ketav sheeno yachol lehizdayyef, velekka! bedaafitzan. veha baenan "tzarich lachazor meinyano shel shetar beshita acharona", velekka! bidmahdar.
Veella may ka mashma lan – dechol lashon kasher?! tenena: get shekketavo ivrit veedav yevanit, yevanit veedav ivrit – kasher!
I mehahi, hava amena: hane mille begittin, aval bishar shetarot – la, ka mashma lan.
Amar shemuel: natan lah neyayr chalak, veamar la: "hare ze gittech" – megoreshet; chayyshinan shemma beme melin ketavo.
Metivi: "hare ze gittech"; unetalattu uzerakattu layyam, o laur, o lechol davar haaved; vechazar veamar: "shetar passim hu", "shetar amana hu" – megoreshet, velo kol hemennu leosrah.
Tama deikka ketav, ha lekka ketav – la! ki kaamar shemuel, devadkinan leh bemayya denara; i palet – palet, vei la palet – lav kelum hu.
Vechi palet may have? hasheta hu defalet! shemuel name, "chayyshinan" kaamar.

Amar ravina: amar li ammemar, hachi amar marimar mishshemeh derav dimi: hane be tere deyahev gitta kammayyhu, tzerichi lemikreyeh. metivi: "hare ze gittech"; unetalattu uzerakattu layyam, o laur, o lechol davar haaved; vechazar veamar "shetar passim hu", "shetar amana hu" – megoreshet, velo chol hemennu leosrah. vei amrat tzerichi lemikreyeh, batar dekaryu mi matze amar la hachi?!
La tzericha, devatar dekaryu ayyeyleh leve yedeh veappekeh, mahu detema: challofe challefeh, ka mashma lan.
Hahu gavra dizrak lah gitta lidvethu levene danne, ishtechach mezuzeta. amar rav nachman: mezuzeta bene danne la shechicha.
Vehane mille deishtechach chada, aval shenayim shelosha – middeha havay, ha name havay; vegitta – emor achbarim shaklu.
Hahu gavra deal leve chenishta, shekal sefer tora yehav lah lidvethu, vaamar la: he gittich. amar rav yosef: lemay lechush la? i mishshum me melin – en me melin al gabbe me melin;

a: I mishshum keritut deit ba – ha baena "vechatav lah" – lishmah, velekka.
Vechi tema, lechush dilma akdem vihav leh zuza lesafra meikkara; ha baenan "shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah", velekka.
Verav yosef may ka mashma lan? sheen me melin al gabbe me melin.
Amar rav chisda: get shekketavo shello lishmah, veheevir alav kulemos lishmah, banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan.

Detanya: hare shehaya tzarich lichtov et hashshem, venitkavven lichtov "yehuda" vetaa velo hetil bo dalet, maavir alav kulemos umekaddesho, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: en hashshem min hammuvechar.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: dilma la hi; ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, devaena ze eli veanvehu, velekka; aval hacha la.
Amar rav chisda: yachelna lemifselinhu (lechulle) [lechullehu] gitte dealma. amar leh rava: may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv "vechatav", vehacha ihi ka katva leh; vedilma aknoye akno leh rabbanan?
Veella mishshum dichtiv: "venatan", vehacha la yahev la midde?! dilma netinat get hi! teda, dishlachu mittam: ketavo al issure hanaa – kasher.
Gufa – shelachu mittam: ketavo al issure hanaa – kasher. amar rav ashe: af anan name tenena: "al heale shel zayit"! dilma shane ale shel zayit, dachaze leitzterofe.
Tanya, rabbi omer: ketavo al issure hanaa – kasher. nefak levi, darsha mishshemeh derabbi, vela kallesu. mishshemeh derabbim, vekallesu. alma hilcheta kevateh.

Tanu rabbanan: "vechatav" – velo chakak. lememra dachakika lav ketiva hi?! ureminhu: eved sheyyatza bichtav sheal gabbe tavla, ufinkas, yatza lecherut. aval lo bichtav sheal gabbe kippa veanduchetari!
Amar ulla, amar rabbi elazar: la kashya – ha dechak tochot, ha dechak yerechot.
Vetochot – la?! ureminhu: lo haya ketavo shokea, ella bolet – kedinre zahav. veha dinre zahav tochot hen!
Kedinre zahav, velo kedinre zahav. kedinre zahav – devolet; velo kedinre zahav – deillu hatam tochot, hacha yerechot.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: rushema – michratz charitz, o kannofe mechannef? amar leh: michratz charitz.
Etiveh: lo haya ketavo shokea, ella bolet kedinre zahav. vei salka datach michratz charitz –
b: Ha baena "michtav", velekka! kedinre zahav, velo kedinre zahav. kedinre zahav – devolet; velo kedinre zahav – deillu hatam, miggavvay; vehacha – meabbaray.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: katav lah get al tas shel zahav, veamar lah: "hitkabbeli gittich vehitkabbeli ketubbatich", mahu? amar leh: nitkabbela gittah venitkabbela ketubbatah.
Etiveh: "hitkabbeli gittich, vehashshear lichtubbaticha" – nitkabbela gittah, vehashshear lichtubbatah.
Tama deikka shear, ha lekka shear – lo!
Hu haddin af al gav delekka shear; veha ka mashma lan – deaf al gav deikka shear, i amar la – in, i la – la.
May tama? avvera dimgilleta hu.
Tanu rabbanan: "hare ze gittich vehanneyayr shelli" – enah megoreshet. "al menat shettachziri li et hanneyayr" – hare zo megoreshet.
Bae rav pappa: ben shita leshita uven teva leteva, may? teku.
Vetippok leh "desefer" echad amar rachamana, velo shenayim ushelosha sefarim! la tzericha, dimore.
Bae rame bar chama: hayu muchezakim beeved shehu shello – veget katuv al yado, vahare hu yotze mittachat yadah, mahu?
Mi amrinan aknoye akni la, o dilma, hu minnafsheh ayel?
Amar rava: vetippok leh dichtav sheyyachol lehizdayyef hu! ulerava, kashya matnitin "al hayyad shel eved"!
Bishlama matnitin lerava la kashya, beede mesira verabbi elazar hi. ella lerame bar chama kashya!
Lerame bar chama name la kashya – bichtovet kaaka. hasheta deatet lehachi, matnitin (lerava) name la tikshe – bichtovet kaaka.
May have ala? ta shema, deamar resh lakish: haggodrot, en lahen chazaka.
Bae rame bar chama: hayu muchezakin betavla shehi shellah – veget katuv aleha; vahare hi yotza mittachat yado, mahu? mi amrinan aknoye aknita leh, o dilma (ishsha) la yada leaknoye?

Amar abbaye, ta shema: af hu heid al kefar katan shehaya betzad yerushalayim, vehaya bo zaken echad, vehaya malve lechol bene hakkefar, vechotev bichtav yado vaacherim chotmim, uva maase lifne chachamim vehichshiruhu. veammay? ha baena "sefer mikna", velekka!
Ella lav, mishshum deamrinan aknoye makne lehu!
Amar rava: umay kusheya? dilma

a: Zaken shane, deyada leaknoye.
Ella amar rava: mehacha – arev hayyotze leachar chittum shetarot, gove minnechasim bene chorin!
Amar rav ashe: may kusheya? dilma gavra shane, deyada leaknoye! ella amar rav ashe: mehacha – ishsha kotevet et gittah, vehaish kotev et shovaro, sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav.
Amar rava: katav lah get, unetano beyad avdo, vechatav lah shetar mattana alav – kenaathu, umitgareshet bo.
Veammay? chatzer mehallechet hi, vechatzer mehallechet lo kana! vechi tema beomed, vehaamar rava: kol sheillu mehallech lo kana, omed veyoshev lo kana! vehilcheta – bechafut.
Veamar rava: katav lah get unetano bachatzero, vechatav lah shetar mattana alav – kenaathu, umitgareshet bo.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan eved, hava amena: davka eved, aval chatzer – ligzar, mishshum chatzerah habbaa leachar mikkan;
Vei ashmeinan chatzer, hava amena davka chatzer, aval eved – ligzar kafut attu sheeno kafut; ka mashma lan.
Amar abbaye: mikkede chatzer mehecha itrabbay? miyyadah";
Ma yadah deita ben middata uven beal kurecha, af chatzerah deita ben middata uven beal kurecha; veha mattana – middata ita, beal kurecha leta!
Matkef la rav shimi bar ashe: veha shelichut lekabbala, demiddata ita beal kurecha leta, veka have shaliach likabbala!
Veabbaye – attu shelichut miyyadah" itrabbay?! mivveshillach veshillechah" itrabbay!
Veibbaet ema: shelichut lekabbala name ashkechan beal kurecha, shekken av mekabbel get levitto ketanna beal korchah.
Al heale shel zayit vechulei: bishlama yad deeved
b: La efshar lemiktzeyay, ella keren shel para – liktzeyay velitteva lah!
Amar kera: "vechatav" – "venatan la", mi sheeno mechussar ella ketiva unetina; yatza ze – shemchussar ketiva, ketzitza unetina.

Rabbi yose haggelili omer vechulei: may tama derabbi yose haggelili? detanya: "sefer" – en li ella sefer, minnayin lerabbot kol davar? talmud lomar: "vechatav lah" – mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "sefer"? ma sefer – davar sheen bo ruach chayyim, veeno ochel; af kol davar – sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel.
Verabbanan – i ketiv "besefer", kidkaamrat; hasheta dichtiv "sefer" – lisfirat devarim hu daata.

Verabbanan, hay "vechatav" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu "bichtiva mitgareshet, veenah mitgareshet bechesef" – salka datach amena, akkesh yetzia lahavayay: ma havayay bechesef, af yetzia name bechesef; ka mashma lan.
Veiddach – nafka leh missefer keritut" – sefer kortah, veen davar acher kortah.

Veiddach – mibbee leh "davar hakkoret beno levenah", kidtanya: "hare ze gittich al menat shello tishti yayin"; "al menat shello telchi levet avich"; "leolam" – en ze keritut. "ad sheloshim yom" – hare ze keritut.
Veiddach – mikkaret–keritut".
Veiddach – "karet–keritut" la darshi.
Mishna en kotvin bimchubbar lakkarka. ketavo bimchubbar, telasho vachatamo unetano lah – kasher. rabbi yehuda posel, ad shettehe ketivato vachatimato betalush.
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: en kotvin lo al hanneyayr hammachuk velo al haddiftera, mippene shehu yachol lehizdayyef. vachachamim machshirin.
Gemara ketavo al hamechubbar?! vehaamrat resha "en kotvin"! amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref.

Vechen amar rabbi elazar, amar rabbi oshaya: vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref – verabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti.
Vehachi kaamar: en kotvin tofes shemma yichtov toref. ketavo lattofes utelasho, ketavo lattoref unetano lah – kasher.
Veresh lakish amar: "chatmu" shaninu; verabbi meir hi deamar ede chatima karti.
Vehachi kaamar: en kotvin toref, gezera shemma yachtom. ketavo lattoref, telasho, chatamo unetano lah – kasher.
Ketavo al cheres shel atzitz nakuv – kasher, deshakel leh veyahev leh nihala. al ale shel atzitz nakuv; abbaye amar: kasher, verava amar: pasul. abbaye amar kasher –

a: Deshakel leh veyahev leh nihala. rava amar pasul – gezera shemma yiktom.
Atzitz shel echad uzeraim shel acher; machar baal atzitz levaal zeraim – kevan shemmashach, kana. machar baal zeraim levaal atzitz – lo kana ad sheyyachzik bizraim.

Atzitz uzeraim shel echad, umecharan leacher; hechzik bizraim – kana atzitz. vezo hi sheshshaninu: nechasim sheen lahem achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut – bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka.
Hechzik beatzitz – af atzitz lo kana, ad sheyyachzik bizraim.
Nikbo baaretz venofo bechutza laaretz? abbaye amar: batar nikbo azlinan. rava amar: batar nofo azlinan.
Bidashrush, kulle alma la feligi. ki peligi – bidla ashrush.
Uvidashrush la peligi?! vehatnan: shete ginnot zo al gav zo, veyarak bentayim, rabbi meir omer: shel elyon. rabbi yehuda omer: shel tachton!
Hatam, kidkatane tama – amar rabbi meir: ma im yirtze elyon littol et afaro, en kan yarak!
Amar rabbi yehuda: ma im yirtze hattachton lemalloot et ginnato afar, en kan yarak!

Veakkatti, bidashrush la peligi?! veha tanya: ilan – miktzato baaretz umiktzato bechutza laaretz; tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: haggadel bechiyyuv – chayyayv, vehaggadel biftur – patur.
May lav, miktzat nofo baaretz umiktzat nofo bechutza laaretz?
Lo; miktzat shorashin baaretz umiktzat shorashin bechutza laaretz. umay tama derabban shimon ben gamliel? demafsik tzunema.
May tama derabbi? dehadri orvi.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: avvera mevalbel, umar savar: hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae.
Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer kulei: amar rabbi chiyyay bar assi mishshemeh deulla, shelosha orot hen: matztza, chippa vediftera.

Matztza – kemashmao, dela meliach udela kemiach udela afitz. lemay hilcheta? lehotzaat shabbat. vechamma shiuro? kidkatane rav shemuel bar yehuda: kede latzur mishkal ketanna. vechamma? amar abbaye: ki riva deriva defumebdita.
Chippa – dimliach, vela kemiach vela afitz. lemay hilcheta? lehotzaat shabbat. vechamma shiuro? keditnan: or – kede laasot kamea.
Diftera – dimliach ukemiach, vela afitz. lemay hilcheta? lehotzaat shabbat. vechamma shiuro? kede lichtov alav et hagget.
Vachachamim machshirin: man chachamim? amar rabbi elazar:
b: Rabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti.
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo hichshir rabbi elazar ella lealtar, aval mikkan ad asara yamim – la; chayyshinan dilma hava beh tenaa vezayyefteh.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu mikkan ad asara yamim; deim ita dahava beh tenay – midkar dechiri.
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo hichshir rabbi elazar ella begittin, aval bishar shetarot – la, dichtiv: "unetattam bichli chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim".
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu bishtarot. vehachtiv: "lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim"! hatam etza tova ka mashma lan.
Mishna hakkol kesherin lichtov et hagget, afillu cheresh, shote vekatan. haishsha kotevet et gittah, vehaish kotev et shovaro. sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav.
Gemara veha lav bene dea ninhu! amar rav huna:

a: Vehu shehaya gadol omed al gabbav.
Amar leh rav nachman: ella meatta, goy – veyisrael omed al gabbav, hachi name dechasher?! vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: goy pasul! goy, ledateh denafsheh aved.
Hadar amar rav nachman: lav milleta hi daamari; demiddeka pasel leh legoy leinyan havaa, mikkelal dilinyan ketiva – kasher.
Vehatanya: goy pasul! hahi rabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti, uvaenan ketiva lishmah; veha vadday goy addateh denafsheh kaaved.
Amar rav nachman, omer haya rabbi meir: afillu metzao beashpa, chatamo, unetano lah – kasher.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: "vechatav lah" – lishmah; may, lav ketivat hagget?! lo, chatimat edim.
Etiveh rava: kol get shennichtav shello leshum ishsha – pasul! ema: shennechtam shello leshum ishsha – pasul.
Etiveh: keshehu kotvo – keillu kotvo lishmah. may, lav keshehu kotvo lattoref lishmah – keillu kotvo lattofes lishmah?!
Lo; keshehu chotmo lishmah – keillu kotvo lishmah. veibbaet ema: hane matnitin manni? rabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti.
Verav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref. vechen amar rabbi chagga mishshemeh deulla: vehu sheshshiyyer mekom hattoref, verabbi elazar hi.
Verabbi zerika amar rabbi yochanan: enah tora. may "enah tora"? amar rabbi abba: kan hodiacha sheen koach lishmah; verabbi meir hi, deamar: ede chatima karti.
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi elazar hi! amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Mishna hakkol kesherin lehavi et hagget, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan, vesome, vegoy.
Kibbel hakkatan vehigdil; cheresh venitpakkeach; some venitpatteach; shote venishtappa; goy venitgayyer – pasul.
Aval pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach; patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach; shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa – kasher. ze hakkelal: kol shettechillato vesofo bedaat – kasher.
Gemara bishlama cheresh, shote vekatan – delav bene dea ninhu; goy name – delav bar hettera hu; ella some, ammay la? amar rav sheshet: lefi sheeno yodea mimmi notlo ulemi notno.
Matkef la rav yosef: heach some muttar beishto? heach bene adam muttarim binshotehem ballayla? ella bitviut ena dekala, hacha name bitviut ena dekala!
Ella amar rav yosef: hacha bechutza laaretz askinan; devae lememar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", vela matze lememar.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, patuach venistamme, dematze amar, hachi name dechasher?! veha katane: patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach, kasher – chazar venitpatteach, in; lo chazar venitpatteach, lo!

Hu haddin deaf al gav delo chazar venitpatteach; veayyeyde dekatane shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa – tama dechazar venishtappa, ha lo chazar venishtappa – la; tena name patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach.
Amar rav ashe: dayka name – dekatane, ze hakkelal: kol shettechillato vesofo bedaat – kasher; vela katane: kol shettechillato vesofo bechashrut – kasher; shema minna.
Beo minneh merabbi amme: eved, mahu sheyyease shaliach lekabbel get ishsha miyyad balah? amar lehu: middeka pasel leh legoy,
b: Mikkelal deeved kasher. amar rav assi, amar rabbi yochanan: en haeved naase shaliach lekabbel get leishsha miyyad balah, lefi sheeno betorat gittin vekiddushin.
Matkef la rabbi elazar: tama bemilleta deleteh, ha bemilleta deiteh – kasher?!
Veha goy veha kuti; deitanhu betorat teruma denafshayyhu, ditnan: haggoy vehakkuti shettarmu mishshellahem – terumatam teruma; utenan: goy shettaram shel yisrael, afillu birshut – en terumato teruma!
May tama? lav mishshum dichtiv: (attem) "gam attem" – ma attem yisrael, af sheluchachem yisrael?!
Amri deve rabbi yannay: lo; ma attem bene berit, af sheluchachem bene berit.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: en haeved naase shaliach lekabbel get ishsha miyyad balah, lefi sheeno betorat gittin vekiddushin, veaf al pi sheshshaninu: "hare at shifcha uveladech ben chorin", im hayta ubbara – zachta lo.

May "im hayta ubbara zachta lo"? ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar, rabbi yochanan tarte amar: nirim devarim shehaeved mekabbel get lachavero – miyyad rabbo shel chavero, aval lo miyyad rabbo shello.
Veim lechashcha adam lomar: zo halacha shenuya – im hayta ubbara, zachta lo! emor lo: shene gedole haddor pershu et haddavar – rabbi zera, verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak.
Chad amar: ha manni? rabbi hi, deamar: hameshachrer chatzi avdo – kana; vechad amar: may tama derabbi beha? kasavar: ubbar yerech immo hu, venaasa kemi shehikna lah echad meevareha.
Mishna af hannashim sheenan neemanot lomar "met balah", neemanot lehavi et gittah – chamotah, uvat chamotah, vetzaratah, vivimtah, uvat balah.
Ma ben get lemita? shehakketav mochiach. haishsha atzmah mevia et gittah, uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam".
Gemara vehatanya: keshem sheen neemanot lomar "met balah", kach en neemanot lehavi gittah! amar rav yosef: la kashya – kan baaretz, kan bechutza laaretz.
Baaretz – delav addibbura dida ka samchinan, mehemna; bechutza laaretz – deaddibbura dida ka samchinan, la mehemna.

Amar leh abbaye: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! baaretz, dei ate baal mearar – mashgechinan beh, deikka lememar lekilkula ka mikkavvevna, la mehemna; bechutza laaretz, dei ate baal mearar – la mashgechinan beh, mehemna.

Tanya kevoteh deabbaye: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi akiva: ishsha neemenet lehavi gittah – mikkal vachomer, uma nashim sheamru chachamim en neemanot lomar "met balah" – neemanot lehavi gittah; hi, shenneemenet lomar "met balah" – eno din shenneemenet lehavi gittah?!

a: Umimmakom shebbata, ma lehallan tzerichot sheyyomru: "befanenu nichtav uvefanenu nechtam", af hi tzericha shettomar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam".
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: haishsha atzmah mevia gittah, uvilvad shettehe tzericha lomar kulei; shema minna.
Verav yosef, resha vesefa bechutza laaretz, metziata baaretz?! in; resha vesefa bechutza laaretz, metziata baaretz.
Mimmay? middekatane: ma ben get lemita – shehakketav mochiach; vela katane: shehakketav ufe mochiach.
Haishsha atzmah mevia vechulei: ishsha, mikki mate gittah leyadah iggarasha la! amar rav huna: beomer "lo titgarshi bo ella bifne bet din peloni". sof sof, ki matya hatam – iggarasha!
Ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: deamar la: ki matet hatam, atnecheh aara veshikleh.
I hachi, hava leh: "teli gittich meal gabbe karka", veamar rava: "teli gittich meal gabbe karka" – lo amar kelum!
Ella deamar la: hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam, vechi matyat hatam hevay shaliach likabbala, vekabbili at gittich.
Veha lo chazra shelichut etzel habbaal! deamar la: hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam, vechi matyat hatam shavvay shaliach likabbala.
Hanicha leman deamar: ishsha osa shaliach lekabbel gittah miyyad sheliach balah. ella leman deamar: en haishsha osa shaliach lekabbel gittah miyyad sheliach baalah, may ikka lememar?
Tama may – mishshum deikka bizzayon devaal, vehacha baal la kafed.
Hanicha leman deamar: mishshum bizzayon devaal; ella leman deamar: mishshum chatzerah habbaa leachar mikkan, may ikka lememar?
Deamar la: hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam, vechi matyat hatam shavvay shaliach leholacha, vekabbili at gittich minneh.
Veibbaet ema, deamar la: hevay shaliach leholacha ad dematyat hatam, vechi matyat hatam emar kamme be dina "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", umeshavve be dina shaliach, velittevu nihalich.
Hadaran alach hammevi get

Kol get shennichtav shello leshum ishsha, pasul. ketzad, haya over bashshuk veshama kol sofrim makrin: "ish peloni megaresh et pelonit mimmakom peloni", veamar: ze shemi veze shem ishti; pasul legaresh bo.
Yater mikken – katav legaresh et ishto venimlach, metzao ben iro veamar lo: shemi keshimcha veshem ishti keshem ishtecha; pasul legaresh bo.
b: Yater mikken – hayu lo shete nashim ushemotehen shavot, katav legaresh et haggedola – lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna.
Yater mikken – amar lelavlar: "ketov, leezo sheertze agaresh" – pasul legaresh bo.
Gemara katav legaresh et ishto venimlach vechulei: veella resha bemay?
Amar rav pappa: besofrin haasuyin lehitlammed askinan. amar rav ashe: dayka name, dekatane "sofrin makrin", vela katane "sofrin korin"; shema minna.
May "yater mikken"? tana deve rabbi yishmael: lo ze – shennichtav shello leshum gerushin; ella af ze – shennichtav leshum gerushin, pasul.

Velo ze – shennichtav shello leshum gerushin dideh; ella af ze – shennichtav leshum gerushin dideh, pasul. velo ze – shello nichtav leshum gerushin ha; ella af ze – shennichtav leshum gerushin ha, pasul.

May tama? i ketav "venatan sefer keritut beyadah", hava amena lemaote haych kamma, dela avid leshum keritut; aval katav legaresh et ishto venimlach, daavid leshum keritut – ema kasher; ketav rachamana: "vechatav".
I ketav rachamana "vechatav", hava amena lemaote hay, dela ihu ka chatev la; aval yesh lo shete nashim, deihu ka chatev la – ema kasher; ketav rachamana: "lah" – lishmah.
Vesefa lema li? ha ka mashma lan – deen berera.
Katav legaresh et haggedola – lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna: ketanna hu dela matze megaresh beh, ha gedola – matze megaresh beh.
Amar rava: zot omeret, shene yosef ben shimon haddarin beir achat – motziin shetar chov al acherim.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, resha dekatane: shemi keshimcha – pasul legaresh bo; sheni hu dela matze megaresh beh, ha rishon matze megaresh beh?! veha amrinan: "velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov"!
Ella may it lach lememar? beede mesira, verabbi elazar hi;
Hacha name – beede mesira, verabbi elazar hi.
Amar rav: kullan poslin bichhunna, chutz min harishon. ushemuel amar: af rishon name posel.
Veazda shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: kol makom sheshshanu chachamim "get pasul" – pasul ufosel. "chalitza pesula" – pesula, ufosaltah min haachin.
Bemareva amri mishshemeh derabbi elazar: semol velayla – pesulot ufoslot,

a: Katan veanpilya – pesulot veen poslot.
Zeeri amar: kullan en poslin, chutz min haacharon.
Vechen amar rav assi: kullan en poslin, chutz min haacharon. verabbi yochanan amar: af acharon name eno posel.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh – deamar rabbi assi, amar rabbi yochanan: haachin shechalku – lakochot hen, umachzirin ze laze bayyovel.
Utzericha; dei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yochanan deen berera, mishshum devaenan "la"– lishmah; aval hatam, mecher – hu deamar rachamana lihdar beyovel, aval yerushsha umattana – la.
Vei ashmeinan sade, mishshum dilchumera; i name, kattechilla; aval hacha – ema la, tzericha.

Bea minneh rav hoshaya merav yehuda: amar lelavlar: "ketov leezo shettetze bappetach techilla", mahu? amar leh, tenetuha: yater mikken, amar lelavlar "ketov leezo sheertze agaresh" – pasul legaresh bo, alma en berera!
Etiveh, haomer levanav: "hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim"; kevan shennichnas rishon rosho verubbo – zacha bechelko, umezakke et echav immo.
Amar leh: hoshaya beri, ma inyan pesachim etzel gittin? ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yochanan: kede lezarzan bemitzvot!

Dayka name, dekatane: kevan shennichnas rishon rosho verubbo – zacha bechelko, umezakke et echav immo. i amrat bishlama deamninhu meikkara – shappir; ella i amrat dela amninhu, leachar shechita mi kamitmenu?! vehatnan: nimnin, umoshchin yedehen mimmennu, ad sheyyishshachet!
Tanya name hachi: maase, vekadmu banot labbanim, venimtzeu banot zerizot uvanim shefalim.
Amar abbaye: ka bae minneh tole bedaat acherim, veka fashet leh tole bedaat atzmo, vahadar motev leh tole bedaat acherim!

Amar rava: may kusheya? dilma, deman deit leh berera – la shena tole bedaat atzmo vela shena tole bedaat acherim, it leh berera, uman delet leh berera – la shena tole bedaat atzmo vela shena tole bedaat acherim, let leh berera!
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava: veha rabbi yehuda, detole bedaat atzmo let leh berera, vetole bedaat acherim it leh berera!
Tole bedaat atzmo let leh berera – detanya: hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer: shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish – hare hen teruma; asara maaser rishon; tisha maaser sheni;
b: Umechel veshote miyyad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin.
Tole bedaat acherim it leh berera – ditnan: ma hi beotan hayyamim?
Rabbi yehuda omer: hare hi keeshet ish lechol devareha, ulechi mayet have gitta.
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava: ha rabbi shimon, detole bedaat atzmo let leh berera, vetole bedaat acherim it leh berera!

Tole bedaat atzmo let leh berera – ha daamaran. tole bedaat acherim it leh berera – detanya: "hareni boalich al menat sheyyirtze abba"; af al pi shello ratza haav – mekuddeshet. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: ratza haav – mekuddeshet,

a: Lo ratza haav – enah mekuddeshet.
Amar leh: ben lerabbi yehuda ben lerabbi shimon; la shena tole bedaat atzmo vela shena tole bedaat acherim – it lehu berera;
Vehatam – kidkatane tama, amru lo lerabbi meir: i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod, venimtza ze shote tevalim lemafrea? amar lahem: lichsheyyibbaka.
Mishna hakkotev tofse gittin, tzarich sheyyanniach mekom haish, umekom haishsha, umekom hazzeman.
Shetare milva – tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hammilva, mekom hallove, mekom hammaot, mekom hazzeman.
Shetare mikkach – tzarich sheyyanniach mekom hallokeach, umekom hammocher, makom hammaot, mekom hassade, umekom hazzeman; mippene hattakkana.
Rabbi yehuda posel bechullan. rabbi elazar machshir bechullan chutz miggitte nashim, shenneemar "vechatav lah" – lishmah.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tzarich sheyyanniach af mekom "hare at mutteret lechol adam"; verabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti, uvaenan ketiva lishmah.
Utzericha;
Dei ashmeinan hach kammayyta, behahi hu deikka leokoma kerabbi elazar, dekatane "en kotvin" vekatane "kitvu";
Aval sefa, dekatane "sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav", ema rabbi meir hi, deamar: ede chatima karti.
Vei ashmeinan behahi, hahi name ikka leokoma kerabbi elazar; aval ha, ema middesefa rabbi elazar have – resha lav rabbi elazar; tzericha.

Mippene hattakkana: may takkana? amar rabbi yonatan: mippene takkanat sofer; verabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti; uvedin hu daafillu tofes name la lichtov, umishshum takkanat sofrim sharu rabbanan.
Rabbi yehuda posel bechullan – gazar tofes attu toref, gazar shetarot attu gittin.
Verabbi elazar machshir bechullan chutz miggitte nashim – tofes attu toref gazar, shetarot attu gittin la gazar.
Shenneemar "vechatav lah": veha ki ketiv "lah" – attoref hu dichtiv!
Ella ema: mishshum shenneemar "vechatav lah" – lishmah.
b: Kashya derabbi elazar adderabbi elazar! tere tannae veallibba derabbi elazar.
Rabbi shabbetay amar chizkiyya: mishshum ketata; verabbi meir hi, deamar: ede chatima karti,
Uvedin hu daafillu toref name lichtov; vezimnin deshama leh lesofer deka chatev, vesavra ihu kaamar leh, vehave la ketata bahadeh.
Rav chisda amar avimi: mishshum takkanat agunot; amri la rabbi meir, veamri la rabbi elazar.
Amri la rabbi meir – deamar: ede chatima karti, uvedin hu daafillu toref name lichtov; vezimnin dehave leh ketata bahada, veratach ala vezarek leh nihala, umeaggen umotev la.
Amri la rabbi elazar – deamar: ede mesira karti, uvedin hu daafillu tofes name la lichtov; vezimnin devae lemezal limdinat hayyam vela ashkach safra, veshavek la veazel, umeaggen umotev la.
Umekom hazzeman: kafasek vetane; la shena min hannissuin, vela shena min haerusin.
Bishlama min hannissuin; ben leman deamar mishshum bat achoto – ikka, ben leman deamar mishshum pere – ikka;
Ella min haerusin; bishlama leman deamar mishshum bat achoto – ikka, ella leman deamar mishshum pere, arusa mi it la pere?!

Amar rav amram: ha milleta shemait minneh deulla deamar mishshum takkanat valad, vela yadana may nihu. kevan deshamita leha detanya: haomer: "kitvu get laarusati, lichsheechnesenna agarshenna", eno get. veamar ulla: ma taam? gezera shemma yomru: gittah kodem livnah. hacha name – gezera shemma yomru: gittah kodem livnah.
Amar rabbi zera, amar rabbi abba bar shela, amar rav hamenuna sava, amar rav adda bar ahava, amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar. kare rav aleh derabbi elazar: tuveyana dechakkime.

Vaafillu bishar shetarot name?! vehaamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: hay ashsharta dedayyayne, demikkatva mikkamme delisahade sahadi achatimat yedayyhu – pesula; alma michze keshikra, hacha name michze keshikra!

Veleta, midderav nachman – deamar rav nachman, omer haya rabbi meir: afillu metzao beashpa, chatamo unetano lah – kasher. vaafillu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi meir ella begitte nashim, devaenan ketiva lishmah, aval bishar shetarot – la.
Deamar rabbi assi, amar rabbi yochanan: shetar shellava bo uferao – eno chozer velove bo, shekkevar nimchal shibudo. tama denimchal shibudo, aval mishshum shikra – la chayyshinan.

a: Mishna hammevi get veavad hemennu; metzao lealtar – kasher, veim lav – pasul. metzao bachafisa o bidloskama, im makkiro – kasher.

Gemara ureminhu: matza gitte nashim veshichrure avadim, deyayteke, mattanot veshovarin, hare ze lo yachazir – sheani omer ketuvin hayu, venimlach alehen shello littenan. ha amar "tenu" – notnin; vaafillu lizman merubbe!
Amar rabba, la kashya: kan bimkom shehashshayyayrot metzuyot, kan bimkom sheen hashshayyayrot metzuyot.
Vaafillu bimkom shehashshayyayrot metzuyot – vehu shehuchezku shene yosef ben shimon beir achat.
Dei la tema hachi, kashya derabba adderabba: dehahu gitta deishtechach be dina derav huna, vahava ketiv beh "bishvire mata deal rachis nahara", veamar rav huna: choshshin lishne shevire;
Vaamar leh rav chisda lerabba: pok veayyen bah, dilureta bae la minnach rav huna. nefak, dak veashkach – ditnan: kol maase bet din – hare ze yachzir.
Veha be dina derav huna, dechimkom shehashshayyayrot metzuyot dame, veka pashet yachzir; alma, i huchezku shene yosef ben shimon beir achat – in, vei la – la.

Avad rabba ovada behahu gitta, deishtechach be chittana befumebdita, kishmateh. ikka deamri beducheta hecha detaru kittana, veaf al gav dehuchezku – dela shechichan sheyayrata; veikka deamri beducheta dimzabbeni kittana, vehu shello huchezku, ushechichan shayyayrot.

Rabbi zera rame matnitin abbarayyta, umeshanne. tenan: hammevi get veavad hemennu, im metzao lealtar – kasher, veim lav – pasul. ureminhu: matza get ishsha bashshuk, bizman shehabbaal mode – yachzir leishsha, en habbaal mode – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. ha
b: Bizman shehabbaal mode mihat – yachzir laishsha, vaafillu lizman merubbe! umeshanne: kan bimkom shehashshayyayrot metzuyot, kan bimkom sheen hashshayyayrot metzuyot.
Ikka deamri vehu shehuchezku hu dela layhdar, vehayeynu derabba; veikka deamri af al gav dela huchezku la layhdar, ufeliga derabba.
Bishlama derabba la amar kerabbi zera, matnitin allima leh leakshoye; ella rabbi zera, may tama la amar kerabba?
Amar lach, mi katane: im amar "tenu" – notnin, vaafillu lizman merubbe? dilma im amar "tenu" notnin kidkayyma lan – lealtar.
Rabbi yirmeya amar, kegon dekaamri edim: meolam lo chatamnu ella al get echad shel yosef ben shimon.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema lechush dilma itremi shema kishma veedim keedim ka mashma lan.
Rav ashe amar, kegon dekaamar: nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit, dehave leh siman muvehak. vedavka betzad ot pelonit, dehave leh siman muvehak, aval: nekev bealma, la;
Mesappeka leh simanin i deorayyta i derabbanan.

Rabba bar bar chana irchas leh gitta be midresha, amar: i simana – it li begavveh, i teviut – ena it li begavveh. ahderu nihaleh. amar: la yadana i mishshum simana ahderu – vekasavri simanim deorayyta, i mishshum teviut ena – vedavka tzureba midderabbanan, aval inash bealma la.

Veim lav – pasul: tanu rabbanan: ezehu shello lealtar? rabbi natan omer: sheshshaha kede shettaavor sheyayra vetishre. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kede sheyyehe adam omed veroe shello avar sham adam. veyesh omrim: shello shaha adam sham. rabbi omer: kede lichtov et hagget. rabbi yitzchak omer: kede likroto. acherim omrim: kede lechotvo velikroto.
Vaafillu shaha, veyesh bo simanin – meidim alav; deamri: nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit. veen meidin al simane hagguf; deamri: aroch vegutz.
Metzao kashur bechis, bearnaki uvetabbaat,

a: O shemmetzao ben kelav; afillu lizman merubbe – kasher.
Ittemar: rav yehuda amar shemuel, halacha: shello shaha adam sham. rabba bar bar chana amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel, halacha: shello avar adam sham.
Lema mar halacha kemar, umar halacha kemar! mishshum deafchi lehu.
Metzao bachafisa o bidloskama: may "chafisa"? amar rabba bar bar chana: chemet ketanna. may "deloskama"? telika desave.
Mishna hammevi get, vehinnicho zaken o chole – noten lah bechezkat shehu kayyaym.
Bat yisrael hannesua lechohen, vehalach balah limdinat hayyam – ochelet bitruma bechezkat shehu kayyaym. hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam – makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyaym.
Gemara amar rava: lo shanu ella zaken shello higgia ligvurot; vechole – sherov cholim lechayyim; aval zaken shehiggia ligvurot, vegoses – sherov gossin lemita; la.
Etiveh abbaye: hammevi get vehinnicho zaken – afillu ben mea shana, noten lah bechezkat shehu kayyaym! teyuveta.
Vei baet ema, kevan deippelig – ippelig.
Rame leh abbaye lerabba, tenan: hammevi get, vehinnicho zaken o chole – noten lah bechezkat shehu kayyaym. ureminhu: "hare ze gittich" – shaa achat kodem lemitato, asura leechol bitruma miyyad!
Amar leh: teruma aggittin ka ramet?! teruma efshar, get la efshar.
Verame teruma atteruma; tenan: bat yisrael hannesua lechohen, vehalach balah limdinat hayyam – ochelet bitruma bechezkat shehu kayyaym.
Ureminhu: "hare ze gittich" – shaa achat kodem mitato, asura leechol bitruma miyyad!
Amar rav adda bereh derav yitzchak: shane hatam, shehare asarah alav shaa achat kodem mitato. matkef la rav pappa: mimmay deihu mayet beresha? dilma ihi mayyta beresha!
Ella amar abbaye, la kashya: ha rabbi meir – dela chayesh lemita, ha rabbi yehuda – dechayesh lemita.
Ditnan: hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer: shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish – hare hen teruma; asara – maaser rishon; tisha – maaser sheni; umechel veshote miyyad – divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin.
Rava amar:
b: Shemma met la chayyshinan, shemma yamut chayyshinan.
Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava: veha nod dichshemma yamut hu, ufeligi! amar rav yehuda middiskarta: shane nod deefshar demasar leh leshomer.
Matkef la rav mesharsheya: arvaych arva tzerich! ella amar rava: shemma met – la chayyshinan, shemma yamut – tannae hi.
Hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam vechulei: veha baena semicha! amar rav yosef: bekorban nashim. rav pappa amar: bechattat haof.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan get – mishshum dela efshar, aval teruma deefshar – ema la.
Vei ashmeinan teruma – dezimnin dela efshar; aval chattat haof – missefeka la leul chullin laazara, tzericha.

Mishna shelosha devarim amar rabbi elazar ben parta lifne chachamim, vekiyyeymu et devarav: al ir shehikkifah karkom, veal hassefina hammuterefet bayyam, veal hayyotze liddon – shehen bechezkat kayyaymin.
Aval ir shekkevashah karkom, usefina sheavda bayyam, vehayyotze lehareg – notnin alehen chumere chayyim vechumere metim – bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal bitruma.
Gemara amar rav yosef: lo shanu ella bevet din shel yisrael; aval bevet din shel ummot haolam, kevan digmir leh dina liktala – miktal katli leh.
Amar leh abbaye: bet din shel ummot haolam name, dimkabbeli shucheda! amar leh: ki shakli – mikkamme delachtom puresi shenamag; levatar demichtam puresi shenamag – la shakli.
Metivi, kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru: "meidin anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet dino shel peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav" – hare ze yehareg! dilma boreach shane.
Ta shema: shema mibbet din shel yisrael shehayu omrim "ish peloni met"; "ish peloni neherag" – yassiu et ishto. mekomentarisin shel goyim "ish peloni met"; "ish peloni neherag" – al yassiu et ishto.
May "met", umay "neherag"? ilema "met" – met mammash, veneherag" – neherag mammash; dichvoteh gabbe goyim, ammay al yassiu et ishto? ha kayyma lan dechol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni leh!
Ella lav "met" – yotze lamut, "neherag" – yotze lehareg? vekatane: bevet din yisrael yassiu et ishto!

Leolam met mammash veneherag mammash, udekaamrat: dichvoteh gabbe goyim ammay la, veha kayyma lan dechol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni; hane mille bemilleta dela shayychi bah, aval bemilleta deshayychi ba, avdi leachzoke shikrayyhu.
Ikka deamri amar rav yosef: lo shanu ella bevet din shel ummot haolam,

a: Aval bevet din shel yisrael, kevan dinfak leh dina liktala – katli leh.
Amar leh abbaye: bet din shel yisrael name, efshar dechazu leh zechuta! ki chazu leh zechuta – mikkamme deligmar dina, batar gemar dina – tu la chazu leh zechuta.
Lema mesayyeya leh: kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru "meidim anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet dino shel peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav" – hare ze yehareg! dilma boreach shane.
Ta shema: shema mibbet din shel yisrael shehayu omrim "ish peloni met"; "ish peloni neherag" – yassiu et ishto. mikkomentarisim shel goyim "ish peloni met"; "ish peloni neherag" – al yassiu et ishto.
May "met" umay "neherag"? ilema "met" – mammash, veneherag" – mammash; dichvoteh gabbe goyim, ammay al yassiu et ishto? ha kayyma lan, kol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni leh!
Ella lav "met" – yotze lamut, veneherag" – yotze lehareg? vekatane: bevet din shel yisrael yassiu et ishto!

Leolam met mammash veneherag mammash; dichvoteh gabbe goyim ammay la, veha kayyma lan dechol mesiach lefi tummo hemone mehemni – hane mille bemilleta dela shayychi ba, aval bemilleta deshayychi ba, avdi leachzoke shikrayyhu.

Mishna hammevi get beeretz yisrael, vechala – hare ze meshallecho beyad acher. veim amar lo: "tol li hemenna chefetz peloni" – lo yeshallechennu beyad acher, sheen retzono sheyyehe pikdono beyad acher.
Gemara amar rav kahana: "chala" tenan. peshita, "chala" katane! mahu detema hu haddin af al gav dela chala, vehay dekatane "chala" orcha demilleta katane; ka mashma lan.
Hechi dame? i daamar leh "holech" – af al gav dela chala name! vei daamar leh "at holech" – afillu chala name la! vei rabban shimon ben gamliel, afillu chala name la!

Detanya: "holech get ze leishti" – hare ze meshallecho beyad acher. "at holech get ze leishti" – hare ze lo yeshallechennu beyad acher. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ben kach uven kach – en hashshaliach ose shaliach.
Ibbaet ema "holech", vehu dechala; vei baet ema "at holech", vechala shane; vei baet ema rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, vechala shane.

Tenan: hammevi get beeretz yisrael, vechala – hare ze meshallecho beyad acher. ureminhu, amar lishnayim: "tenu get leishti"; o lishlosha: "kitvu get utenu leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. inhu in, aval shaliach la!
Amar abbaye: hatam tama may – mishshum bizzayon devaal, hacha baal la kafed.
Rava amar: mishshum demille ninhu, umille la mimmasran leshaliach.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu sheliach mattana; uviflugeta derav ushemuel – rav amar: mattana enah keget. ushemuel amar: mattana hare hi keget.
Veim amar lo "tol li hemenna chefetz peloni". amar resh lakish: kan shana rabbi: en hashshoel rashshay lehasheil, veen hassocher rashshay lehasekir.

Amar lo rabbi yochanan: zo, afillu tinokot shel bet rabban yodim otah! ella zimnin degitta name la have – denaasa kemi sheamar lo "al tegarshah ella babbayit", vegershah baaliyyay; "al tegarshah ella beyamin", vegershah bismol.
Dechulle alma, hecha denafka leappeh veyahava leh chefetz, vahadar shakla minneh gitta; kulle alma la peligi degitta – gitta mealleya have. ki peligi hecha daamar leh:
b: Shekol minna chefetz vahadar hav la gitta; vaazal ihu vihav la gitta, vahadar shekal minna chefetz. rabbi yochanan posel bo, vechol shekken bishlucho, veresh lakish machshir bishlucho, vechol shekken bo.

Mishna hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, vechala – ose shaliach bevet din umeshallecho, veomer lifnehem: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"; veen shaliach acharon tzarich sheyyomar "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", ella omer: sheliach bet din ani.

Gemara amaru leh rabbanan laavimi bereh derabbi avahu: bae minneh merabbi avahv, shaliach deshaliach meshavve shaliach, o la? amar lehu: ha la tibbee lechu, middekatane "en hashshaliach haacharon", michlal dimshavve shaliach;
Ella ki tibbee lechu: ki meshavve shaliach – bevet din, o afillu shello bevet din? amaru leh: ha la mibbaya lan, middekatane: ella omer "sheliach bet din ani".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi: amaru leh rabbanan laavimi bereh derabbi avahu, bei minneh merabbi avahu: shaliach deshaliach, ki meshavve shaliach – bevet din, o shello bevet din?

Amar lehu: vetibbee lechu i meshavve shaliach bealma! amaru leh: ha la ka mibbaya lan, ditnan: "en hashshaliach haacharon", mikkelal deshaliach meshavve shaliach; ella ki ka mibbaya lan – bevet din, o shello bevet din? amar lehu: ha name la tibbee lechu, dekatane: ella omer "sheliach bet din ani".
Amar rabba: shaliach beeretz yisrael, ose kamma sheluchin. amar rav ashe: im met rishon – batlu kullan.

Amar mar bar rav ashe: ha deabba, dekatnuta hi! illu met baal, midde meshasha it behu?! kullehu mikkoach man kaatu – mikkoach devaal kaatu; iteh levaal – itanhu lechullehu, leteh levaal – letanhu lechullehu.

Hahu gavra deshaddar la gitta lidvethu, amar shaliach: la yadana la, amar leh: zil yahaveh leabba bar minyome, deihu yada la, velezil velitteveh nihala. ata vela ashkach leabba bar minyome. ashkecheh lerabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappa verabbi yitzchak nappacha, veyatev rav safra gabbayyhu. amaru leh: mesor millach kamme didan, dechi yete abba bar minyome nittevineh leh, velezil velittevineh la.
Amar lehu rav safra: veha sheliach shello nittan legerushin hu! ikkesufu.
Amar rava: kappechinhu rav safra litlata rabbanan semivche. amar rav ashe: bemay kappechinhu? mi kaamar leh "abba bar minyome vela at"?!
Ikka deamri, amar rava: kappechinhu rav safra litlata rabbanan semivche, betauta. amar rav ashe: may tauta? may ka amar leh: "abba bar minyome" – vela at!
Hahu gavra deshaddar lah gitta lidvethu, amar leh leshaliach: la titteveh nihala ad telatin yomin. ittenis bego telatin yomin.

Ata lekammeh derava, amar rava: chala tama may – mishshum daanivs, hay name [ha anis] (anus hu). amar leh: mesor millach kamme didan, dilvatar telatin yomin meshavvenan shaliach, veyahev leh nihala. amaru leh rabbanan lerava: veha shaliach shello nittan legerushin hu! amar lehu: kevan dilvatar telatin yomin matze megaresh, keshaliach shennittan legerushin hu.
Velechush shemma piyyes! mi la tenan: "meachshav – im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh – hare ze get.
Vehavenan ba: venechush shemma piyyes! veamar rabba bar rav huna, hachi amar abba mari mishshemeh derav: beomer "neemenet alay lomar shello bati"!
Ikkesif. lesof iggallay milleta daarusa havay. amar rava: im amru binsua – yomru baarusa?!
Amar rava: ha vadday ka mibbaya lan –

a: Ki meshauu bet din shaliach; befanav, o shello befanav? hadar pashta: ben befanav ben shello befanav. shelachu mittam: ben befanav ben shello befanav.
Hahu daamar: i la atena ad telatin yomin – leheve gitta. ata ufaskeh mabbara. amar lehu: "chazo daatay", "chazo daatay". amar shemuel: la shemeh matya.
Hahu daamar lehu: i la [m]fayyesna la ad telatin yomin – leheve gitta. azal payyeysa, vela ippayyaysa. amar rav yosef: mi yehav la tarkabba dedinare vela ippayyaysa?!
Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef: midde tarkabba dedinare bae lemittav la?! ha payyeysa, vela ippayyaysa.
Ha – keman deamar yesh ones begittin, ha – keman deamar en ones begittin.
Mishna hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani, lihyot mafrish alehen mechelkan; mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyaymin, veeno choshesh shemma met hakkohen o hallevi, o heeshir heani.
Metu – tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshim; im hilvon bifne bet din – eno tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshin.
Gemara veaf al gav dela atu lideh?!
Amar rav: bemakkare kehunna uleviyya. ushemuel amar: bimzakke lahem al yede acherim. ulla amar: ha manni – rabbi yose hi, deamar: asu et sheeno zoche kezoche.
Kullehu kerav la amri – bemakkare la katane. kishmuel la kaamri – bimzakke la katane. keulla name la amri – kichidaa la mokminan.
Tanu rabbanan: hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani, lihyot mafrish alehen mechelkan, mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyaymin;
Ufosek immahen keshaar hazzol; veen bo mishshum ribbit; veen sheviit meshammatto;
Veim ba lachazor – eno chozer. nityayashu habbealim – en mafrish alehem, lefi sheen mafrishin al haavud.
Amar mar: posek immahem keshaar hazzol – peshita! ha ka mashma lan, af al pi shello pasak – kemi sheppasak dame.
Veen bo mishshum ribbit – may tama? kevan dechi let leh – la yahev leh, ki it leh name – en bo mishshum ribbit.
Veen sheviit meshammatto – dela karena beh "lo yiggos".

Veim ba lachzor, eno chozer – amar rav pappa: lo shanu ella baal habbayit bechohen; aval kohen bevaal habbayit, im ba lachzor – chozer. ditnan: natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu perot – yachol lachzor bo.
Nityayashu habbealim en mafrish alehen, lefi sheen mafrishin al haavud – peshita! la tzericha, daakun; mahu detema akanta milleta hi, ka mashma lan.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi bevet din, vametu – mafrish alehen bechezkat oto hashshevet. veet heani bevet din, vamet – mafrish alav bechezkat aniyye yisrael. rabbi achay omer: bechezkat aniyye olam.
May benayyhu?
b: Ikka benayyhu aniyye chutiyyim.
Heeshir heani – en mafrish alav, vezacha halla bema shebbeyado.

Verabbanan, may shena lemita daavud takkanta, umay shena laashirut dela avud takkanta? mita shechicha, ashirut la shechicha. amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: chavrach mit – ashshar, itashshar – la teashshar.
Met – tzarich littol reshut vechulei: tanya, rabbi omer: yorshin sheyyarshu. umi ikka yorshin dela yarti?! ella amar rabbi yochanan: sheyyarshu karka, velo sheyyarshu kesafim.
Amar rabbi yonatan: hinniach melo machat – gove melo machat. melo kardom – gove melo kardom. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu hinniach melo machat – gove melo kardom;
Uchemaase dekattina deabbaye.
Tanu rabbanan: yisrael sheamar lelevi: "maaser yesh lecha beyadi", en choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo. "kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi" – choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo.

May kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: yisrael sheamar lelevi "maaser yesh lecha beyadi, vehelach damav", en choshshin shemma asao terumat maaser al makom acher. "kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi, vehelach damav", choshshin shemma asao terumat maaser al makom acher.
Attu berashshie askinan, deshakli deme umeshauu leh terumat maaser?!

Ella amar rav mesharsheya bereh derav idi, hachi kaamar: yisrael sheamar leven levi "maaser leavich beyadi, helach damav", en choshshin shemma asao aviv terumat maaser al makom acher. "kor maaser leavich beyadi, vehelach damav", choshshin shemma asao aviv terumat maaser al makom acher.
Vechi nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf?!

Ella amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: ben yisrael sheamar lelevi "kach amar li abba: maaser lecha beyadi" o "maaser leavich beyadi" – choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo, kevan dela kitz la hava metakken leh baal habbayit. "kor maaser lecha beyadi" o "kor maaser leavich beyadi" – en choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo, kevan dekitz takkone takkeneh baal habbayit.
Vechi yesh lo reshut levaal habbayit litrom terumat maaser?! in, abba elazar ben gamla hi. detanya, abba elazar ben gamla omer: "venechshav lachem terumatchem" –

a: Bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber: achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser; keshem shetteruma gedola nittelet beomed uvemachshava, kach terumat maaser nittelet beomed uvemachshava; ucheshem sheyyesh lo reshut levaal habbayit litrom teruma gedola, kach yesh lo reshut levaal habbayit litrom terumat maaser.

Mishna hammanniach perot, lihyot mafrish alehen teruma umaasrot; maot, lihyot mafrish alehen maaser sheni – mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyaymin. im avdu – hare ze choshesh meet leet, divre rabbi elazar.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bishlosha perakim bodkin et hayyayin – bekiddum shel motzae hachag, uvehotzaat semadar, uvishat kenisat mayim bevoser.
Gemara may meet leet? rabbi yochanan amar: meet leet shel bedika. rabbi elazar ben antignos omer mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi yannay:
b: Meet leet shel hannacha.
Tenan: im avdu – hare ze choshesh meet leet. bishlama leman deamar meet leet shel bedika – shappir;
Ella leman deamar meet leet shel hannacha – hay "meet leet"?! "ad meet leet" mibbee leh! kashya.

Divre rabbi elazar: amar rabbi elazar: chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi elazar – ditnan: mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser; kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea – ben birshut hayyachid, ben birshut harabbim – temeot.
Peshita dachalukin! mahu detema: may "lemafrea" – meet leet, ka mashma lan.
Rabbi yehuda omer, bishlosha perakim kulei: tana: bekiddum shel motzae hachag shel tekufa.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bishlosha perakim mochrin et hattevua – lifne hazzera, uvishat hazzera, uvifros happesach. uvishlosha perakim mochrin et hayyayin – bifros happesach, uvifros atzeret, uvifros hachag. veshemen – meatzeret veelach. lemay hilcheta? amar rava, veittema rav pappa: leshuttafin. mikkan veelach, may? amar rava: kol yoma pirkeh hu.
"Vayhi kizroach hashshemesh vayman elohim ruach kadim charishit" – may "charishit"? amar rav yehuda: beshaa shemmenashshevet, ose telamim telamim bayyam.

Amar leh rabba: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv: "vattach hashshemesh al rosh yona vayyitallaf"?! ella amar rabba: beshaa shemmenashshevet, meshatteket kol haruchot mippaneha. vehayeynu dichtiv: "asher begadecha chammim behashekit eretz middarom". amar rabbi tachlifa bar rav chisda, amar rav chisda: ematay begadecha chammim? beshaa shehishkit eretz middarom. shebbeshaa shemmenashshevet meshatteket kol haruchot mippaneha.

Rav huna verav chisda havo yatvi. chalef veazel geniva alayyhu, amar chad lechavreh: nekum mikkammeh, devar oryayn hu. amar leh iddach: mikkamme palgaa nekum?! addehachi ata ihu legabbayyhu, amar lehu: bemay askitu? amaru leh: beruchot.

Amar lehu: hachi amar rav chanan bar rava, amar rav: arba ruchot menashshevot bechol yom, veruach tzefonit menashshevet im kullan; sheilmale ken, en haolam mitkayyem afillu shaa achat. veruach deromit kasha mikkullan, veilmale ben netz maamidah, machrevet kol haolam kullo mippaneha, shenneemar: "hamibbinatcha yaaver netz yifros kenafav leteman".

Rava verav nachman bar yitzchak havo yatvi; hava chalef veazel rav nachman bar yaakov, deyatev beguharka dedahava uferis aleh sarbala decharate. rava azal legabbeh, rav nachman bar yitzchak la azal legabbeh. amar: dilma meinashe deve resh galuta ninhu; rava tzarich lehu, ana la tzerichna lehu.

Kedachaza derav nachman bar yaakov hava, azel legabbeh. galli lidraeh, amar: shadya nashev! amar rava, hachi amar rav: ishsha mappelet bo; ushemuel amar: afillu margalit shebbayyam markevet bo; rabbi yochanan amar: afillu shichvat zera shebbime ishsha masrachat bo.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, usheloshtan mikra echad darshu: "ki hu ben achim yafri yavo kadim ruach Adonai mimmidbar ole veyevosh mekoro vegomer". "yevosh mekoro" – zo mekorah shel ishsha. "veyecherav mayayno" – ze shichvat zera shebbime ishsha. "hu yishse otzar kol keli chemda" – zo margalit shebbayyam.
Amar rava: ade suraa hu, dedayyki kerae! may "ki hu ben achim yafri"? amar rava: afillu

a: Shufeta bekofina demara – rafya. rav yosef amar: afillu sikketa bedafna – rafya. rav acha bar yaakov amar: afillu kanya bechufeta – rafya.
Hadaran alach kol get

Hashsholeach get leishto, vehiggia bashshaliach o sheshshalach acharav shaliach, veamar lo: "get shennatatti lecha, batel hu" – hare ze batel. kiddem etzel ishto o sheshshalach etzlah shaliach, veamar lah: "get sheshshalachti lich, batel hu" – hare ze batel. im mishshehiggia get leyadah – shuv eno yachol levattelo.
Barishona haya ose bet din mimmakom acher umevattelo, hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shello yehu osin ken, mippene tikkun haolam.
Gemara "higgio" la katane, ella "higgia" – vaafillu mimmela, vela amrinan letzaora hu deka mikkavven.
"O sheshshalach acharav shaliach" – lema li? mahu detema: la allima shelichuteh devatra mishshelichuteh dekamma – dilvatteleh, ka mashma lan.
"Kadam hu etzel ishto" – lema li? mahu detema: ki la amrinan letzaora ka mikkavven – hane mille leshaliach, aval ledida vadday letzaora ka mikkavven, ka mashma lan.
"O sheshshalach etzlah shaliach" – lema li? mahu detema: ihu hu dela tarach addata letzaora, aval shaliach, dela ichpat leh ki tarach – vadday letzaora ka mikkavven, ka mashma lan.
Im mishshehiggia get leyadah – eno yachol levattelo. peshita! la tzericha demahdar aleh meikkara levattole; mahu detema: iggallay milleta lemafrea devattole batteleh, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: "batel hu"; "i efshi bo" – devarav kayyaymin. "pasul hu"; "eno get" – lo amar kelum.

Lememra devatel" lishshana delibbetil mashma?! vehaamar rabba bar ayvu, amar rav sheshet; veamri la amar rabba bar avu: mekabbel mattana, sheamar leachar shebbata mattana leyado: "mattana zo mevuttelet"; "tibbattel"; "i efshi bah" – lo amar kelum. "betela hi"; "enah mattana" – devarav kayyaymin. alma "batel" meikkara mashma!
Amar abbaye: "batel"
b: Shete leshonot mashma – mashma devatel, umashma delibbetil. gabbe get lishshana demahane beh kaamar, gabbe mattana lishshana demahane ba kaamar.
Amar abbaye, nekitinan: sheliach mattana hare hu kishliach hagget; nafka minna leholech" lav kizchi" dame.
Ravina ashkecheh lerav nachman bar yitzchak ditle vekae beivra dedashsha, veka mibbaya leh: "batel" mahu? teku.
Amar rav sheshet, veamri la bematnita tana: "get ze lo yoil"; "lo yattir"; "lo yaaziv"; "lo yeshallach"; "lo yegaresh"; "yehe cheres"; "yehe kecheres" – devarav kayyaymin.
"Eno moil"; "eno mattir"; "eno maaziv"; "eno meshalleach"; "eno megaresh"; "cheres hu"; "kecheres hu" – lo amar kelum.
Ibbaya lehu: "hare hu cheres", mahu? amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava, veamri la rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: may shena mehare hu hekdesh"; "hare hu hefker"?
Chozer umegaresh bo, o eno chozer umegaresh bo? rav nachman amar: chozer umegaresh bo; verav sheshet amar: eno chozer umegaresh bo. vehilcheta kevoteh derav nachman.
Ini?! veha kayyma lan hilcheta kevoteh derabbi yochanan, deamar: chozeret.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam – dibbur vedibbur hu, ate dibbur umevattel dibbur; vehacha – nehi devatteleh lishlichuta deshaliach, gitta gufeh mi ka vatel?
